title: Ontario’s premier urges thaw in U.S.-Canada trade war: ‘We’re best friends.’
summary_full: After days of trading insults with President Donald Trump, Ontario Premier Doug Ford said it was vital for the American and Canadian economies that the countries strike a trade deal.
summary_public: After days of trading insults with President Donald Trump, Ontario Premier Doug Ford said it was vital for the American and Canadian economies that the countries strike a trade deal.
